factsText: Property: Azure North 1204 (Azure Urban Resort Residences, Parañaque). Sleeps up to 4 guests, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom. Check-in 2 PM, check-out 12 NN. Self check-in: no. Weekday rate PHP 3,200 per night, weekend rate PHP 3,800 per night. Security deposit PHP 2,000, refundable after checkout. Pet fee PHP 500. Guest parking PHP 300 per night, arranged with the host. Payment methods: GCash 0999-888-7777 (Juan D.). Cancellation: Flexible, full refund up to 7 days before check-in. Amenities: wifi, kitchen, washing machine, smart TV, pool access (7 AM to 10 PM, pool fee PHP 150 per guest). House rules: no parties, no smoking indoors, quiet hours 10 PM to 7 AM.
